name: Apple Charlies
tagline: Apple Charlie’s South Huron Orchards & Cider Mill
description: Apple Charlies is an on-farm market in 38035 S. Huron, MI, selling produce straight from the field. Because everything is sold where it is grown, selection follows the local harvest calendar. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Availability follows the local growing season, so what is on offer changes through the year.
